steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Aaahhh...!!</color></size>
The enormous body begins to crumble and contamination is spilling everywhere, finally exposing that ugly red lump of flesh. In a hysterical moment, it charges straight at you and clings onto you.

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: I have descended! I must live eternally! Give me your blood and flesh! Give it all to me!!

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: It's you, it's you!! Give yourself to me, give me your shackles and your everything! You cannot escape!!
You don't flinch. The shackles break up the filth and charge straight toward that lump of bloody flesh. But at the moment of contact, a massive shock grinds over both of you.

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: Ahhh...!! That's impossible! That's impossible!! How can you...

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Let go!!</color></size>

This has never happened before. The shouts are tearing at your nerves and the contamination is cutting through your consciousness. Countless filthy hands are sticking onto your body. The hands turn into mouths and devour your soul.

But you're doing the same. The shackles released from your hands have split into countless blood-red thorns, rushing into that enormous black hole in such an intense and eager manner never before seen.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aaahhh..!! Stop it, stop it!! My head hurts, stop it now!!

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: I see, you're... you're the same...

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: But you are just a defective! You, you're mine!

You can't stop yourself at all. The pain and obsession intertwined in your body are roaring and overwhelming your will, rousing terrifying instinct. Something is fusing with your body and dissolving your consciousness...
The pain and obsession intertwined in your body are roaring, and your instinct has been roused. You begin to fuse into its body and dissolve its consciousness...
It's stopped answering. Laughing hysterically, it clings onto you, as if there's nothing else left in this world. It starts to drag you into the abyss.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief! Chief, let go! It's swallowing you! Let go...!!

You can't hear anymore. You can only see, in the center of the black hole —a human shape, a haggard human shape letting out a heart-wrenching wail and raising a hand at you. You've seen this hand before...

It feels so familiar and so dear. Devouring each other and yearning for each other, yearning for the bones, blood, and souls, yearning for a passionate awakening, yearning to return to the beginning...
That's enough!
Swoosh!

In that white-hot moment, a blade flashes before you but you can't even make out the shape of the weapon clearly. That malicious eyeball is pierced through and bursts open. The power gnawing at you disappears.
Next, all of its remains swarm into your body like a hurricane, smashing and piercing through your soul, drawing out all of your strength.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!
Finally hearing her voice, you fall onto the ground. Hecate is holding you up and your vision is all blurry. Hella is watching all of this, her eyes filled with fear.
The Corpseborne's enormous body has finally burned down completely. Two human shapes detach from the wreckage.
Zoya has lost consciousness, but... she's still alive.
The other person has been burned to ashes, the body shattering into dust the moment it touches the ground.
He used himself as bait and tried his best to distract the Corpseborne from Zoya for a while, opening up a path for the shackles.
He bet everything on you.
A female stranger walks out of the flying ashes. She's covered in injuries and her breathing is slightly unstable.

options: What was that thing that entered my body just now?

steps.content: Shh—I'm here to provide some after-sales service, and I don't have time to flirt. We'll get to know each other when we have another chance.

Before you finish, that unsteady figure suddenly appears right in front of you. Before you even make out her features, she's already leaning close to your ear. A hand is on your chest and you feel a slight press.
My business card... Keep it safe, alright?
Woah, woah, let's be more discreet now, Chief. There are kids here, that sounded a bit too explicit...

Before you finish, that unsteady figure suddenly appears right in front of you. Before you even make out her features, she's already leaning close to your ear. A hand is on your chest and you feel a slight press.
<size=30>It's not time yet... It's still too soon for you...</size>
You reach out to grab her, but she's suddenly gone again. Your hands are empty and there's nothing on your chest.
But at the moment of contact, something enters your body—you don't feel sick or strange at all. It comes, then it goes.
The woman leaves you and walks toward the figures detached from the Corpseborne. She carries Zoya on her shoulder and takes one last look at the man who's been burned to ashes.

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: Good work, Second-in-command... You did your best...

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: You're not a bad person. But it's safer for her to come with me now.

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: No need to chase after me so eagerly now, take care of yourself first, our lovely Chief. Your path will not be easy from now on.

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: ...I'll see you around.
She turns and leaves.
You want to catch them, but the manic substance that's rushed into your body is still boiling, and you don't even have enough strength to get up.
A helicopter's rumbling is nearing. You hear Nightingale's shouts, but you have no strength left to answer her.
